defects.title: comparability_requirements_ref is unbound to consumed requirement results
implementation: pre553_temporal_comparability.py:987 serializes the ref into provenance
defects.impact: Changing the ref while retaining the same caller result tuple does not change derivation; the exact requirement set is not resolved or authenticated.

defects.title: governed-use scope is reduced from ExactRef to object_id
implementation: resolve_required_authority accepts governed_use_id as str and scope-checks that reduced value
defects.exact_ref_law: ExactRef identity is kind + object_id + content_hash.
defects.impact: Same object_id with different exact material can pass the same target-use scope.

defects.title: temporal identity contract is not resolved against TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE
implementation: TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE resolution is independent of the identity ref
defects.impact: Arbitrary exact identity ref plus a true caller boolean can pass the identity gate.

defects.title: SOURCE_EQUIVALENCE relation result is not resolved through the source-relation owner path
implementation: pre553_temporal_comparability.py:785-807 checks ref presence plus an authority snapshot
pre553_source_relations.py:173-190 defines an authorized RelationDecision carrying relation_ref
defects.impact: An arbitrary source_equivalence_ref can be accepted when a scoped authority snapshot exists; the already-resolved exact relation result required by the contract is bypassed.

defects.title: target_use_permission_refs consumes only element zero
defects.implementation: pre553_temporal_comparability.py:728-730 indexes only target_use_permission_refs[0] and never validates/records additional supplied refs
defects.impact: Additional bound permission refs can be silently ignored.

cardinality.fewer_than_two: TEMPORAL_INSUFFICIENT_ANCHORS receipt retained by HQ214; conflicts with the closed receipt field's exact_cardinality=2 and is recorded as a contract tension, not an additional blocker
